scientific_integrity: Two separately implemented exhaustive enumerators verify the finite counts; the orbit classification uses a fully checked explicit automorphism action. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification confined to ordinary resolving sets on the 30-vertex Tutte–Coxeter graph; earlier unindexed equivalent enumeration remains possible. Scalar metric dimension six is prior knowledge.
title: All 32,460 metric bases of Tutte's eight-cage in 34 symmetry classes
